name: Detail Depricarping (Web)

endpoints.description: Ambil 1 record Depricarping lengkap beserta seluruh baris Depricarping Detail-nya (berapapun jumlahnya, tidak lagi selalu 24 sejak revisi 2026-08-24), station_name, dan nama user (Inputted By/Checked By/Acknowledged By) untuk halaman Detail

business_logic: 1. findOrFail(id) → if not found: return 404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND (via ModelNotFoundException)
2. Eager-load station, createdBy, checkedBy, acknowledgedBy, depricarpingDetails
3. Map depricarpingDetails (berapapun jumlahnya, termasuk nol) ke urutan canonical time-slot (bukan urutan insert), resolve nama-nama user

data_operations.description: findOrFail by id dengan eager-load relasi
SELECT seluruh baris (berapapun jumlahnya) terkait record, di-sort ke urutan canonical time-slot

edge_case_handling.handling: ModelNotFoundException → 404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND, Livewire component set notFound=true
checked_by_name/acknowledged_by_name bernilai null, ditampilkan sebagai '-' di Blade
Route middleware role: gate menolak dengan 403

edge_case_handling.condition: Record memiliki nol baris Depricarping Detail
edge_case_handling.handling: details array kosong dikembalikan, FE tampilkan grid kosong/empty-state, bukan error

business_rules_applied: Hanya Supervisor/Mill Management/Admin yang dapat mengakses
Grid Depricarping Detail ditampilkan langsung dari data tersimpan, menampilkan persis baris yang ada (revisi 2026-08-24: tidak lagi selalu 24)

unit_test_cases.description: throws ModelNotFoundException when getDetail id does not exist
unit_test_cases.given: a random uuid not in the database

unit_test_cases.description: returns the full record with resolved station_name when id exists
unit_test_cases.expect: result.id matches, result.station_name matches the station's name

unit_test_cases.description: returns details array sorted into canonical time-slot order, not alphabetical, regardless of how many rows exist
unit_test_cases.given: detail rows created out of canonical order (14:00, 08:00, 00:00)
unit_test_cases.expect: details sorted as [08:00, 14:00, 00:00] per canonical index

unit_test_cases.description: returns an empty details array when the record has zero depricarping-detail rows
unit_test_cases.given: record tanpa depricarping-detail rows sama sekali

unit_test_cases.description: returns null checked_by_name and acknowledged_by_name when not set
resolves created_by_name, checked_by_name, acknowledged_by_name to user names when present
unit_test_cases.given: record with all 3 user FKs set
unit_test_cases.expect: all 3 name fields resolved to the corresponding users' names

screen_dependencies.reason: Entry point (klik baris) dan tujuan Back
Tombol Edit membuka Form Depricarping (Web) mode ubah

implementation_notes: Reuses DepricarpingRecordService::getDetail() (BE service shared with screen-051, see that screen's implement artifact for the service/controller/route files)

Target Operasional table queried DIRECTLY by DetailDepricarping::render() (DepricarpingOperationalTarget::orderBy('sort_order')->get()) -- NOT part of the GET /api/depricarping-records/{id} response -- per this screen's tech-spec direction, mirrors DetailPressing (screen-054) exactly, with 4 columns instead of 3

Field grouping/order in the Blade view mirrors mobile/src/views/DataPreviewDepricarpingView.vue's detail mode exactly (Presser ID, Tanggal, Inputted By, Checked By, Acknowledged By, Note, grid, Target Operasional table), per explicit product direction that web station screens mirror mobile flow/UX
Route /data/depricarping/{id} registered after /data/depricarping/create (screen-059) so the literal 'create' segment is not swallowed by {id}

REVISI 2026-08-24 (entity-catalog v12): grid Depricarping Detail pada Blade view ini TIDAK PERNAH mengasumsikan 24 baris tetap -- sudah sejak awal me-render `@foreach ($record['details'] as $row)` langsung dari array details, tanpa literal '24' di manapun (dikonfirmasi via grep) -- TIDAK ADA perubahan fungsional pada layar ini akibat revisi grid dinamis di Form Depricarping (screen-059)/mobile (screen-043), hanya doc comment/wording di artifact ini yang diperbarui

component_test.assert: renders presser_id, the Depricarping Detail grid with however many rows the record has, and the 4-column operational target table
